name: Tensho
description: A kata that emphasizes circular movements and soft techniques, representing the 'ju' aspect of Goju-Ryu.
history: Tensho was developed by Chōjun Miyagi as a complement to Sanchin.
culturalSignificance: This kata is used to develop techniques and understanding in Goju-Ryu training.
